info.name: Genscape Oil Production and Forecasting
info.description:
Upstream production and refinery run forecast data. This data currently includes:
 * US Daily Oil Production
 * US Oil Production Forecast
 * Canadian Daily Oil Production
 * Canadian Oil Production Forecast-By Region
 * Canadian Oil Production Forecast-By Asset

request.description:
Monthly estimates of US oil production broken out by region and crude quality. Also included are gas and oil rig counts and reported actuals. The main forecast is updated on Mondays every 6 weeks, with weekly adjustments made every Monday in between. Reports date back to 3/29/2013 with data available back to January 2006 and forecasted forward 5 years. Estimates reflect prices from the previous Friday.

* All updates subject to holiday delays - refer to the Holiday delay schedule for rescheduled publication dates

request.description:
Daily regional estimates of crude oil production in thousands of barrels per day (Mbd). Data is updated every weekday at around 11am ET. 
All updates subject to holiday delays - refer to the Holiday delay schedule for rescheduled publication dates. 
Estimates go back as far as July 1, 2013. Data is calibrated to monthly facility and provincial-level regulatory reports. 
Values are broken into five distinct production “streams”, defined as follows:
 * Western Canada Conventional – region: westernCanada, item: conventionalCrudeProduction
 * Crude Bitumen – region: alberta, item: crudeBitumenProduction
 * Synthetic Crude Oil – region: alberta, item: syntheticCrudeProduction
 * Atlantic Offshore – region: atlanticOffshore, item: crudeOilProduction
 * Total Canadian Oil Production – region: canada, item: crudeOilProduction
